app TypedTextBooleans
Given
 Profile { name:text="initial", enabled:bool=false, names:text[], flags:bool[], seedNames:text[]=["a","b"], seedFlags:bool[]=[true,false], maybeNames:text[]?, maybeFlags:bool[]?, maybeName:text?, maybeEnabled:bool? }
 policy Profile read=public
When
 crud Profile by=members fields=name,enabled,names,flags,seedNames,seedFlags,maybeNames,maybeFlags,maybeName,maybeEnabled
 ## True joins the names; false keeps the supplied scalar name. Failed acceptance rolls back either set.
 scenario change(profile:Profile,name:text,enabled:bool,names:text[],flags:bool[],accept:bool) -> text by=members
  do
   require all(names as item,item!="")
   if enabled
    set profile {name=join(names,"/"),enabled=enabled,names=names,flags=flags}
   else
    set profile {name=name,enabled=enabled,names=names,flags=flags}
   require profile.enabled==enabled and all(profile.flags as flag,flag==enabled)
   require accept
   return profile.name
 ## Trim the supplied text; blank names roll back the staged change.
 scenario normalize(profile:Profile,value:text) -> text by=members
  do
   let normalized=trim(value)
   set profile {name=normalized}
   require [profile.name]==[normalized]
   require profile.name>""
   return profile.name
 scenario active(profile:Profile) -> bool by=members
  do return profile.enabled
 scenario names(profile:Profile) -> text[] by=members
  do return profile.names
 scenario flags(profile:Profile) -> bool[] by=members
  do return profile.flags
 scenario maybeNames(profile:Profile) -> text[]? by=members
  do return profile.maybeNames
 scenario maybeFlags(profile:Profile) -> bool[]? by=members
  do return profile.maybeFlags
 ## Omitted literal parameters are resolved once and retain original receipt values.
 scenario defaults(name:text="hello",enabled:bool=true,names:text[]=["a","b"],flags:bool[]=[true,true]) -> text by=members
  do
   require enabled and all(flags as flag,flag)
   return join([name,join(names,"/")],":")
Then
